interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.55.0 adds six Python stdlib-only hygiene, egress, cloud-sync, onboarding and ADR improvements selectively adapted from seulee26/stock-team-harness (v2.4.0, MIT): verification-date staleness warnings (checked-at-stale, review-by-passed) and deterministic alias-collision lint in vault_lint_extensions.py, URL query-parameter credential/signature inspection (egress-url-secret) in vault_egress.py, read-only cloud-sync destination awareness and first-run capability summaries (vault_cloud_sync.py, vault_doctor --cloud-sync and --summary, plus non-blocking stderr warnings in backup_vault.py and vault_okf.py), pre-registered ADR invalidation triggers in assets/templates/decisions.md, and unexplained conclusion-reversal review guidance in commands/vault-lint.md. Retained from v0.54.1: expanded Default_Ignorable invisible Unicode stripping (U+00AD, U+034F, U+061C, U+200E, U+200F, U+3164, U+FFA0), UTF-8 BOM cleanup and CI guard, POSIX parent-directory fsync in backup_vault.py, and SHA-256-verified advisory actionlint (v1.7.12, MIT). Retained from v0.54.0: invisible Unicode smuggling/bidi stripping, opt-in hook-wiring auditing (vault_hook_wiring.py), deterministic install-state tracking and ownership-guarded uninstall (vault_install_state.py), static CI hygiene/portability/workflow security tests, and scripts/verify_release_claims.py. No new runtime dependencies; Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. Because vault_lint_extensions.py and vault_egress.py are two of the seven certificate-bound checker files, v0.55.0 transitions checker_sha256 cleanly with zero false positives on the unchanged harmless corpus; where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
